57651-ambition-and-success.title: Success
57651-ambition-and-success.creator: Unknown
57651-ambition-and-success.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. God is whispering into the ear of all existence, of every created thing “Look up.” Every sentient thing in the universe seems to be trying to get to a higher level. Everything is in the process of evolution, and the evolution is always upward. The butterfly does not become a grub. It is not the evolutionary law. The grub develops into a butterfly. It is never the other way.

arxiv-2102-03941.title: The Spanning Tree Model for the Assembly Kinetics of RNA Viruses.
arxiv-2102-03941.creator: Inbal Mizrahi, Robijn Bruinsma, Joseph Rudnick
arxiv-2102-03941.description: Abstract We present a simple kinetic model for the assembly of small single-stranded RNA viruses that can be used to carry out analytical packaging contests between different types of RNA molecules. The RNA selection mechanism is purely kinetic and based on small differences between the assembly energy profiles.

arxiv-2107-04149.title: Euler-Rodrigues formula for three-dimensional rotation via fractional powers of matrices
arxiv-2107-04149.creator: Flank D. M. Bezerra, Lucas A. Santos
arxiv-2107-04149.description: Abstract . In this short paper, we review the Euler-Rodrigues formula for three-dimensional rotation via fractional powers of matrices. We derive the rotations by any angle through the spectral behavior of the fractional powers of the rotation matrix by π 2 \frac{\pi}{2} in ℝ 3 \mathbb{R}^{3} about some axis. Mathematics Subject Classification 2010 : 37E45, 15A04, 47D03.

arxiv-2203-00362.title: Reasonable Space for the λ \lambda -Calculus, Logarithmically ∗
arxiv-2203-00362.creator: Beniamino Accattoli ORCID:0000-0003-4944-9944, Ugo Dal Lago ORCID:0000-0001-9200-070X, Gabriele Vanoni ORCID:0000-0001-8762-8674
arxiv-2203-00362.description: Abstract . Can the λ \lambda -calculus be considered a reasonable computational model? Can we use it for measuring the time and space consumption of algorithms? While the literature contains positive answers about time, much less is known about space.

arxiv-2302-07437.title: Bridging the Usability Gap: Theoretical and Methodological Advances for Spectral Learning of Hidden Markov Models
arxiv-2302-07437.creator: Xiaoyuan Ma
arxiv-2302-07437.description: Abstract The Baum-Welch (B-W) algorithm is the most widely accepted method for inferring hidden Markov models (HMM). However, it is prone to getting stuck in local optima, and can be too slow for many real-time applications. Spectral learning of HMMs (SHMM), based on the method of moments (MOM) has been proposed in the literature to overcome these obstacles.

arxiv-2310-14151.creator: Wei Zhu, Xiaoling Wang, Huanran ZhengEast China Normal UniversityMosha ChenHoloflow Digital Technology, HangzhouBuzhou TangHarbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen
arxiv-2310-14151.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Wei Zhu, Xiaoling Wang, Huanran ZhengEast China Normal UniversityMosha ChenHoloflow Digital Technology, HangzhouBuzhou TangHarbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen. Biomedical language understanding benchmarks are the driving forces for artificial intelligence applications with large language model (LLM) back-ends.

arxiv-2401-02513.title: GeV-scale dark matter with p p -wave Breit-Wigner enhanced annihilation Preprint: LAPTH-002/24, IPPP/23/85
arxiv-2401-02513.creator: Genevieve Bélanger, Sreemanti Chakraborti, Yoann Génolini, Pierre Salati
arxiv-2401-02513.description: Abstract We consider a light scalar dark matter candidate with mass in the GeV range whose p p -wave annihilation is enhanced through a Breit-Wigner resonance. The annihilation actually proceeds in the s s -channel via a dark photon mediator whose mass is nearly equal to the masses of the incoming particles.

arxiv-2405-14815.title: Designing A Sustainable Marine Debris Clean-up Framework without Human Labels Conference: ACM SIGCAS/SIGCHI Conference on Computing and Sustainable Societies; July 8–11, 2024; New Delhi, India ACM SIGCAS/SIGCHI Conference on Computing and Sustainable Societies (COMPASS ’24), July 8–11, 2024, New Del
arxiv-2405-14815.creator: Raymond Wang, Nicholas R. Record, D. Whitney King, Tahiya Chowdhury
arxiv-2405-14815.description: Abstract . Marine debris poses a significant ecological threat to birds, fish, and other animal life. Traditional methods for assessing debris accumulation involve labor-intensive and costly manual surveys. This study introduces a framework that utilizes aerial imagery captured by drones to conduct remote trash surveys. Leveraging computer vision techniques, our approach detects, classifies, and maps marine debris distributions.

arxiv-2501-10353.title: Invariant tori for the pressure-jump Hamiltonian
arxiv-2501-10353.creator: R.S.MacKay in memory of Bob Dewar
arxiv-2501-10353.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by R.S.MacKay in memory of Bob Dewar. A major achievement of Dewar and coworkers is the SPEC code to construct stepped-pressure equilibria in magnetohydrostatics without axisymmetry. Their existence had been proved by Bruno and Laurence. As part of the procedure of Bruno and Laurence, it is required to solve the Hamilton-Jacobi equation for a magnetic potential on the outside of an interface given the field on the inside and the pressure-jump across the interface.

arxiv-2501-18267.title: Cancellative elliptic Artin monoids
arxiv-2501-18267.creator: Georges Neaime
arxiv-2501-18267.description: Abstract . We define new presentations for elliptic Artin groups. We also show that the elliptic monoids defined by these presentations are cancellative. This solves the failure of cancellativity for the presentations of elliptic Artin monoids that were introduced before in the literature. Our approach also paves the way to construct Garside structures for elliptic Artin monoids and groups. 1.

arxiv-2510-07878.title: FlowLensing : Simulating Gravitational Lensing with Flow Matching
arxiv-2510-07878.creator: Hamees Sayed, Pranath Reddy, Michael W. Toomey, Sergei Gleyzer
arxiv-2510-07878.description: Abstract Gravitational lensing is one of the most powerful probes of dark matter, yet creating high-fidelity lensed images at scale remains a bottleneck. Existing tools rely on ray-tracing or forward-modeling pipelines that, while precise, are prohibitively slow. We introduce FlowLensing , a Diffusion Transformer-based compact and efficient flow-matching model for strong gravitational lensing simulation.

arxiv-2601-07941.title: Moonworks Lunara Aesthetic Dataset
arxiv-2601-07941.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by . This data card presents the first public release of the Lunara Aesthetic Dataset, a curated set of 2,000 image–prompt pairs for controlled research on prompt grounding and style conditioning in text-to-image generation systems. The dataset spans diverse artistic styles, including regionally grounded aesthetics from the Middle East, Northern Europe, East Asia, and South Asia, alongside general categories such as sketch and oil painting.

pmc-10571926.title: Investigating Owner Use of Dietary Supplements in Dogs with Canine Cognitive Dysfunction
pmc-10571926.creator: Julia Haake, Nina Meyerhoff, Sebastian Meller, Friederike Twele, Marios Charalambous, Volker Wilke, Holger Volk, Mandy Paterson
pmc-10571926.description: Simple SummaryCanine cognitive dysfunction is considered the canine equivalent to human Alzheimer’s disease. It is a growing concern in veterinary medicine, as it affects many aged dogs. Dietary intervention with different diets and supplements may improve clinical signs and prevent further degeneration.

pmc-11362028.title: Editorial: New directions and trends in parenting research
pmc-11362028.creator: Yosi Yaffe, Nicolette Vanessa Roman, Dorit Alt
pmc-11362028.description: orary aspects and fields within this domain. Parenting science has expanded significantly over the past five decades to understand parenting, the parent-child relationship, child development and the adjusted adult. The shift has been from behaviorism to attachment and child development, positive parenting, and the role of technology.

pmc-11473188.title: Ramucirumab‐induced ascites with endothelial growth factor receptor mutation‐positive non‐small cell lung cancer: Two case reports
pmc-11473188.creator: Keisuke Shiraha, Tomoki Tamura, Taisaku Koyanagi, Takahiro Umeno, Kazuya Nishii, Shoichi Kuyama
pmc-11473188.description: Ramucirumab (RAM) has been approved for the treatment of non‐small cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Here, we report two cases of RAM‐induced ascites with epidermal growth factor receptor‐mutant NSCLC. Patient 1, a 72‐year‐old man, developed ascites 20 months after erlotinib (ERL) and RAM administration, which resolved after their discontinuation and performing paracentesis.

pmc-11475234.title: Diagnostic Utility of Canine C-Reactive Protein, Haptoglobin, and 25-Hydroxyvitamin-D in Dogs with Nasal Cavity Disease
pmc-11475234.creator: Sarah Rösch, Julia Woitas, Gerhard Ulrich Oechtering, Aki Fujiwara-Igarashi
pmc-11475234.description: Simple SummaryThe diagnosis of nasal cavity disease (ND) in dogs typically requires comprehensive diagnostics under general anesthesia including cross-sectional imaging and rhinoscopy. Therefore, dogs with nasal discharge are often only presented for diagnostics after weeks of symptomatic or even antibiotic therapy, even though primary bacterial rhinitis is uncommon.

pmc-11678846.title: Up-to-Date Snapshot of Current and Emerging Medical Therapies in Primary Biliary Cholangitis
pmc-11678846.creator: Zakary Warsop, Nikhil Anand, Husam Al Maliki, Shuell De Souza, Arya Kamyab, Amin Al Hadad, Laith Alrubaiy
pmc-11678846.description: Background/Objectives: Primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) is an autoimmune chronic cholestatic disease of the liver that symptomatically can present with pruritus and fatigue. Its established first- and second-line therapies are ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) and obeticholic acid (OCA) although they provide limited symptom management. Liver transplantation offers a potentially curative therapeutic option in refractory cases progressing to cirrhosis.

pmc-12468950.title: TLR4 rs2149356 Polymorphism in Periodontitis and End-Stage Renal Disease: An Exploratory Analysis in Egyptian Patients
pmc-12468950.creator: Asmaa Abou-Bakr, Fatma E A Hassanein, Nermeen Nagi, Mihad Ibrahim, Mohamed Mekhemar, Nejat Düzgüneș, Kazuhito Satomura
pmc-12468950.description: This study explored the association of the TLR4 rs2149356 polymorphism with periodontal and renal parameters in Egyptian end-stage renal disease (ESRD) patients. Ninety-two patients with periodontitis were recruited, forty-six on hemodialysis, and forty-six systemically healthy controls. Clinical periodontal indices, renal biomarkers, and gGenotyping for TLR4 rs2149356 were assessed. Gingival inflammation was significantly higher in ESRD patients across all genotypes.

pmc-12511342.title: Magnetic tunnel junction made of abundant materials for memory and dynamic applications
pmc-12511342.creator: Mariusz Cierpiał, Dawid Maślanka, Kacper Gubała, Jakub Mojsiejuk, Krzysztof Grochot, Jerzy Wrona, Jürgen Langer, Tianxiang Nan, Witold Skowroński
pmc-12511342.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Magnetic tunnel junction (MTJ) used currently for data storage are characterized by perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, which is beneficial in terms of low current density required for switching and the thermal stability of the free magnetic layer. The other ferromagnet of MTJ, namely the reference layer is fixed using so-called synthetic antiferromagnetic (SAF) structure, which typically involves less-abundant material, such as Pt or Pd. We present an alternative stack structure, with the SAF based on Ni-Co superlattices, which is Pt-free.

pmc-13122648.title: Elucidation of the Guanitrypmycin Biosynthetic Pathway in Kitasatospora azatica Leading to Structure Revision and Reassignment
pmc-13122648.creator: Philipp Mann, Shu-Ming Li
pmc-13122648.description: A recently reported incorrect structure revision and assignment of guanitrypmycins raised our attention and encouraged us to clarify the disagreement with additional experimental data. Genome mining of Kitasatospora azatica revealed the presence of a biosynthetic gene cluster for guanitrypmycin-type alkaloids.

pmc-13199383.title: Potential biomarkers and preventative interventions for muscle wasting in adolescent and young adults with cancer: A translational study
pmc-13199383.creator: Savannah V Rauschendorfer, Fei Wang, Guanshu Liu, Prince Jeyabal, Corwin Zigler, You Zhou, J Andrew Livingston, Michael E Roth, Behrang Amini, Eugenie S Kleinerman
pmc-13199383.description: Adolescent and young adults (AYAs) with sarcoma and our mouse model were used to evaluate early and late effects of doxorubicin (Dox) on skeletal muscle and the impact of physical activity on preventing Dox-induced damage. Skeletal muscle changes in 46 AYAs were quantified using computed tomography scans pre- and post- high-dose Dox treatment. Physical activity was monitored via wearable device.

pmc-13316623.title: Development and validation of a multiplex TaqMan real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction assay for selected pro-inflammatory immune-response gene expression in chickens
pmc-13316623.creator: Xin Ye, Chuan-Yu Hsu, Linan Jia, Christopher Magee, Spencer Leigh, Jeffrey Evans, Li Zhang, Kelsy Robinson
pmc-13316623.description: Accurate quantification of host immune gene expression is essential for elucidating host–pathogen interactions and inflammation regulation in poultry infection studies. However, many existing chicken immune gene-expression assays rely on singleplex reactions or intercalating-dye chemistry, which may limit throughput and target specificity.

pmc-13556809.title: 180. Effects of MC-100093, GLT-1 enhancer, in mesocorticolimbic brain regions of C57BL/6 mouse exposed to hydrocodone overdose using comprehensive laboratory monitoring system
pmc-13556809.creator: Y Sari, W Wong, W Childers, M Abou-Gharbia
pmc-13556809.description: BackgroundChronic exposure and overdose of opioid cause neurotoxicity through alterations of several neurotransmitters, including glutamate. Targeting glutamate transporter 1 (GLT-1) may attenuate the effects of chronic exposure to drugs of abuse. Thus, the effects of novel GLT-1 enhancer, MC-100093, and β-lactam ceftriaxone, were evaluated in C57BL/6 mice exposed to hydrocodone overdose.

pmc-13575594.title: Institutional Learning Curve in Esophagectomy: Technical Standardization of Gastric Conduit Formation and Conduit‐Related Outcomes in 187 Consecutive Patients
pmc-13575594.creator: Mayank Tripathi, Reshma R. Balachandran, Kumar Vineet, Dhaval Vadodaria, Vaibhav Kushwaha, Mohd Irfan Ansari, Piyush Shukla
pmc-13575594.description: BackgroundLearning curves in esophagectomy are often described in terms of procedural volume, but institutional maturation also reflects progressive standardization of reconstruction, operative choreography, and team‐based decision‐making. Gastric conduit viability remains central to safe esophageal reconstruction, with conduit ischemia, torsion, and tension contributing substantially to leak and necrosis.
